## Overview

Plays an entrance when the element is created and, inside `*movePresence`, a leave before it is
removed — the one-attribute `[move]` / `[moveAnimate]` shorthand.

Stable API — covered by semantic-versioning guarantees.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Stability:** `stable`

## Selector

```text
[move],[moveAnimate]
```
